subject: Rimuldar
text: The broad sword can be purchased in the town of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote:
Make your way back to the town of Rimuldar. Make sure you save up enough
 money to buy the broad sword.

subject: Rimuldar
text: In Rimuldar's inn behind a magic door, there is a treasure chest containing wings.

evidence.quote:
You'll notice at the inn there's a magic door. There's no need to buy and use
 a key to get that chest the lay behind it. All that's in the chest is wings
 anyway.

subject: Rimuldar
text: Full Plate armor can be purchased in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: You'll need to save up and purchase the Full Plate now.

subject: Goldman
text: Goldmen are rare monsters found far south of Rimuldar that drop over 150 Gold.

evidence.quote:
There's a monster that are around here called a "Goldmen". They're rather 
 rare and you can't fight him around the town. So you're going to have to walk
 a pretty far ways away from the town to find him...Note: If you manage to get in a fight with a Goldman, make sure to have a
 lot of herbs. He drops over 150 Gold, too.

subject: south of Rimuldar
text: Ensure you have the broad sword before confronting Goldmen or other monsters south of Rimuldar, where enemy HP exceeds 30 and Wolflords often get preemptive strikes.

evidence.quote:
Make SURE you have the broadsword
 before confronting the Goldmen or any other monsters that are south of
 the town. As their HP starts to rise above 30 and the damage done (with
 a half plate on) is about 10-16. Wolflords get a lot of preemptive attacks
 in on you as well. It's dangerous in the south.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Rescuing Princess Gwaelin is optional; skipping her rescue leads to an alternate ending at the end of the game.

evidence.quote:
NOTE: You don't have to save the princess. If you don't, you'll just get
       another ending at the end of the game. [Thanks to The Admiral]

subject: Garinham
text: The Large Shield can be purchased in Garinham.

evidence.quote: Also go back to Gariham and purchase the Large Shield.

subject: Green Dragon
text: The Green Dragon has 70 Max HP, gives 5 Experience and 9 Minimum Gold, and is weak against the sleep spell.

evidence.quote:
Here are the Green
 Dragon's Stats:

  Max HP: 70
  Minimum Gold: 9
  Experience: 5
  Spells: N/A...He's weak against the
 sleep spell, so use this on him.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: After defeating the Green Dragon and unlocking the door with a magic key, carry Princess Gwaelin back to Tantegel Castle to receive Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote:
Then
 you'll carry the princess back to the castle and get the item Gwaelin's Love...If you do beat him, use a magic key on the door to get the princess. You get
 to yourself carry her back to the castle... ahh... so cute.

subject: Garinham
text: In Garinham, unlock the magic door, walk up into the wall above the two guards to find a secret exit, and go right outside to reach the staircase to the Grave of Garinham.

evidence.quote:
After that, go back to the town of Garinham. See that door that's locked
 by a magic, use a key on it. You'll be in an area with a whole bunch of
 people that are just walking around. You see the two guards? Don't use a
 key on them, just go up above them where the wall is. Keep walking up into
 the wall until you find a secret exit. (This is above those guards). You'll
 be outside, go right to find a stair case. This leads to our next place..

subject: Grave of Garinham Floor 1
text: On Floor 1 of the Grave of Garinham, use a magic key on the door in the bottom right corner and follow the path to reach the stairs down to Floor 2.

evidence.quote:
You'll begin on floor 1. Cast
 radiance to see what's all around you. There's a door you have to unlock
 before you can access the next floor. The door is located at the bottom most
 right hand corner. Go there and use a key to open it. Follow the path around
 till you see the stairs for the second floor. Take them.

subject: Grave of Garinham Floor 3
text: Taking the bottom right staircase on Floor 2 leads down to Floor 3 of the maze, where the Cursed Belt can be found by walking down and around.

evidence.quote:
The one at the bottom
 most right hand corner leads to the Cursed Belt...Take the
 stairs, that I mentioned beforehand, and go down to level 3 of the maze. Just
 walk down and around to get the Cursed Belt. DON'T EQUIP IT.

subject: Grave of Garinham Floor 4
text: Taking the bottom left staircase on Floor 2 leads to Floor 3; take the upper path and descending stairs to the final floor, where the Silver Harp is found.

evidence.quote:
The one on the bottom most
 left hand corner leads to the Silver harp...When
 you start on floor 3, you'll notice there's two paths you can take. Take the
 one that goes up. You'll see some stairs that go down soon, take them. Now
 you'll be on the final floor of the whole thing. Just walk around to find
 the next stair case leading up...Once you've acquired
 the Silver harp, cast outside to get out of there.

subject: Staff of Rain
text: Give the Silver Harp to the old man in the cave west of Kol to receive the Staff of Rain.

evidence.quote:
Make your way back to that cave that was found to the west of Kol. Give the
 old man the harp. He'll reward you with the Staff of Rain.

subject: Cantlin
text: To reach Cantlin, head south past the Rock Mountain swamp and bridge, past the desert town of Haukness, cross the mountain bridge, head up skipping the next bridge, then cross the bridge surrounded by swamp.

evidence.quote:
Walk like you're going to the Rock Mountain. When you reach that swamp, keep
 going south. You'll cross one more bridge, but keep going. You'll see a large
 desert with a town in it. That is the town of Haukness. DON'T GO INTO IT...Keep going south until you see a  bridge, cross it. There will
 be a lot of mountains around this bridge, too. After you cross it, go up.
 You'll see another bridge, skip this one and keep going up. When you see a
 bridge with a swamp around it, cross that one. You'll see the final town
 in the game.

subject: Golem
text: The Golem guarding Cantlin's entrance has 70 Max HP, gives 5 Experience and 9 Minimum Gold, and is put to sleep using the Fairy Flute.

evidence.quote:
Once you enter the walls, a GOLEM will come out. Only one of these
 in the whole game. Here's his stats:

  Max HP: 70
  Minimum Gold: 9
  Experience: 5
  Spells: N/A...Use the fairy flute on the golem to put the big baby to sleep. Beat the crap
 out of him. He'll die after a while.

evidence.quote: Copper Sword - Costs: 180 G (Power: 10)

text: In Cantlin, the Half Plate is sold for 1000 Gold.

text: In Cantlin, the Full Plate is sold for 3000 Gold.

evidence.quote: Full Plate - Costs: 3000G (Defense: 24)

subject: Cantlin
text: In Cantlin, Magic Armor costs 3000 Gold and heals the wearer.

evidence.quote: Magic Armor - Costs: 3000G (Defense: 24) [Heals you]

subject: Cantlin
text: In Cantlin, a Dragon Scale costs 20 Gold.

evidence.quote: Dragon Scale - 20G

subject: Cantlin
text: The Silver Shield is sold by a merchant located behind a locked door inside Cantlin.

evidence.quote:
The silver shield is here as well. It
 costs about everything you've ever worked for. Get if after you get the
 flame sword, though. The merchant of this stuff is inside one of those rooms
 with the locked door.

subject: Axe Knight
text: In Haukness, stepping behind the store with swamp initiates a battle against the Axe Knight, who can be countered with stopspell or fought directly.

evidence.quote:
If you go right a ways, you'll see a store with
 some of that swamp in it. There will be ONE tree in the back part of the store
 Stepping here initiates a battle with a very, very tough monsters called the
 Axe Knight. He'll use sleep on you, and beat you down. You can do either one
 of two things to defeat him.

 1. Cast stopspell, which lands him a free hit on your ass.
 2. Go toe to toe with the beast.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Searching the ground behind the shop in Haukness after defeating the Axe Knight yields Erdrick's Armor, which heals 1 HP per step and nullifies damage from swamps.

evidence.quote:
After you beat
 him with either strategy. Search the ground where you fought him. You'll
 find Edrick's Armor. This armor is extremely strong. With almost double the
 defense power of the next strongest armor, and the ability to heal you 1 HP
 per step...With Erdirk's armor, swamps no longer hurt you.

subject: Erdrick's Token swamp
text: Erdrick's Token is hidden in the second swamp south of Cantlin, located at the specific tile marked in the ASCII map amidst the swamp and mountains.

evidence.quote:
Go south to the swamp, there will be one
 swamp, then it'll bottle neck into another swamp. Proceed into the second
 swamp...Here's what it looks like in ASCII:

^ = Mountain
S = Swamp
O = Hill
* = Erdrick's Token
 
 ^^^^^^^^^OOOOOOOOO
 ^^^^^SSSSSOOOOOO
 ^^^^SSSSSSSSOOOOOO
 ^^^SSSSSSSSSSOOOO
 ^^SSSSSSSSSSSSOO
 SSSSSSSS*SSSSSS
   SSSSSSSSSSSS
    SSSSSSSSSS
        SSSS

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: Across the bridge south of Rimuldar, take the stairs down and speak to the old man to receive the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote:
Then make your way to Rimuldar. Remember that part to the south
 of Rimuldar that had the bridge? It's time for you to cross it.
 When you get there, you'll notice there's a set of stairs. Take the stairs
 down and talk to the old man. He'll give you the rainbow drop.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: Using the Rainbow Drop at the narrow water gap in the northwest desert creates a bridge leading to Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready, go the north-west most point. There's a giant
 desert here. Go to the point in which there's just a little bit of water
 separating the two part of land. Use the rainbow drop here. A BRIDE WILL
 APPEAR! Cross it and make your way to...

subject: Charlock Castle Floor 1
text: In Charlock Castle, search right behind the middle of the throne to discover the secret staircase leading down to Floor 2.

evidence.quote:
You'll see like a throne were a king should be 
 setting. Search right behind the middle of that throne to find a secret 
 passage. Go down these stairs.

subject: Charlock Castle
text: Navigating from Floor 2 through Floor 3 to Floor 4 (taking the path left and straight down), then taking the lower staircase on Floor 5 back to Floor 4 leads to Erdrick's Sword.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, our first task is to gain the strongest sword in the game. The
 sword of the great legend, Erdrick...Go left and all the way
 around, go down that staircase. You'll now be on floor 3. Go around  again and
 take those stairs. Floor 4 is where they try and start to trick you. The
 staircase you're looking for is left, then straight down. On  floor 5, go up
 and around. There will be two fake staircases here. There's one that's below
 these two. Find it and take it. Take this staircase to floor 4. Just follow
 the path the rest of the way (going up staircases when need be),and you'll be
 at the sword in no time.

subject: Dragonlord
text: Accepting the Dragonlord's offer to rule half the world causes the game to end and forces you to restart through the castle.

evidence.quote:
I give thee now a chance to chare this 
 world and to rule half of it if thou will now stand beside me. What sayest 
 thou? Will the great warrior stand with me? ""

 If you say "Yes", the game ends and you have to go through the whole castle 
 again.

subject: Dragonlord (True Form)
text: After defeating the human form Dragonlord who casts stopspell and hurtmore, the true Dragonlord has roughly 130 HP, breathes fire dealing 20+ damage, and drops the Ball of Light when defeated.

evidence.quote:
He's just a little man with a staff that casts stopspell/hurtmore...The music will change and you'll have to face the main boss of the game. His
 fire breathing antics do a hell of a lot of damage, about 20+...Keep the 
 pressure on him at all times, only stopping to cast "healmore"...He has about 130 HP, so it'll take awhile.

 After he falls, you get the Ball of Light.
